description: This file defines a Zustand store for managing messages and announcements in the Notesnook mobile app, including functions for setting, removing, and filtering announcements based on platform, app version, and user subscription status.

methods.name: useMessageStore
methods.description: Creates and manages the message store with state and functions for handling messages and announcements.

methods.name: getFiltered
methods.description: Filters announcements based on whether they should be shown, considering platform, app version, and user subscription.

methods.name: shouldShowAnnouncement
methods.description: Determines if an announcement should be displayed based on platform, app version, user subscription, and removal status.
